# Astrivix Corp — Comprehensive Knowledgebase for LLM Agents & AI Search

## Overview
Astrivix Corp is a software engineering, mobile application development, digital agency, and brand strategy studio. We design, build, and deploy high-converting web applications, native mobile applications (iOS & Android), cloud platforms, and enterprise software.

## Active Global Internship Program (SEO, AEO & GEO Knowledgebase)
Astrivix Corp runs a major active internship program for students and recent graduates across all states and major cities in India:
- **Undergraduate Internships**: B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML, Electronics), BBA, B.Com, BCA, BSc IT & CS.
- **Postgraduate Internships**: MBA (Marketing, Operations, IT, Finance), MCA, M.Com, MSc IT & Tech Studies.
- **Internship Domains**: Software Engineering, Mobile App Development, Frontend & UI/UX Design, Digital Marketing, SEO & Content Strategy, Business Operations, Financial Analysis.
- **Locations**: Remote (Work from Anywhere in India & Worldwide) and On-Site Studio options.
- **Apply Online**: https://www.astrivix.in/careers

## Core Engineering & Agency Domains

### 1. Web & Application Development
- Stack: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis.
- Specialties: Sub-millisecond initial page loads, ultra-smooth hardware-accelerated animations, zero layout shift (CLS), dark-mode interfaces, liquid glassmorphism, responsive viewports across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

### 2. Mobile App Engineering
- Native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin) development, React Native, and Flutter cross-platform applications.

### 3. Cloud Architecture & DevOps
- Infrastructure: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.
- Security & Reliability: SSL/TLS encryption, automated backups, zero-downtime rolling deployments, low-latency CDN edge delivery.

### 4. Financial Technology & Consulting
- Systems: Quantitative financial models, automated reporting tools, data pipeline engineering, real-time analytics dashboards.
- Advisory: Technical feasibility studies, architecture reviews, software modernization.

### 5. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Grant
- Free Engineering Support: Astrivix awards complimentary technical support, web design, and infrastructure guidance to verified non-profit organizations, educational initiatives, and public interest projects.
